definitions.explanation: Managing to do something despite difficulty; finding a way to accomplish something.
Used when you can't remember or don't want to specify a name or word.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}とか⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}いました→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I somehow made it in time.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}とか⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧{何|なん}とかさん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いう→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's a person named Tanaka something-or-other.
examples.notes: When you can't remember the full name

examples.japanese: {何|なん}とか⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}すれば→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧よかった。
examples.english: I somehow managed to pass the exam, but I should have studied a bit more.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{何|なん}とか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いう→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧、⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧？⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧やつ。
examples.english: Have you seen that whatchamacallit movie? The one with the famous actor.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}とか⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I'm somehow managing to get by.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}とか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いう→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a book called something-or-other.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}とか⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦みた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I tried talking to what's-his-name, the section chief.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{何|なん}とかってお⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧？
examples.english: Is that whatchamacallit shop still there?

notes:
{何|なん}とか has two distinct uses: (1) "somehow" when managing despite difficulty, and (2) "something" as a placeholder for forgotten or unspecified names.

USE 1 - SOMEHOW:
- {何|なん}とか{間|ま}に{合|あ}った: I somehow made it in time
- {何|なん}とかなる: things will work out somehow
- {何|なん}とかして: to manage somehow, to do something about it

USE 2 - PLACEHOLDER:
- {田中|たなか}{何|なん}とかさん: Tanaka what's-his-name
- あの{何|なん}とかという{映画|えいが}: that whatchamacallit movie

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana (なんとか) in casual contexts.
